title: Two-point blow-up estimate for a C¹ map at an interior point
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝⁿ (Rn n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) be open, let G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Amb n ℓ) be C¹ on U (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G U), let x ∈ U, ρ ∈ ℝ and ε > 0, and put L := fderiv ℝ G x. Then for all sufficiently small t > 0, i.e. eventually along 𝓝[>] 0: (a) x + t•v ∈ U for every v in the closed ball closedBall(0, ρ) of ℝⁿ; and (b) ‖t⁻¹•(G(x + t•v) − G(x + t•v')) − L(v − v')‖ ≤ ε‖v − v'‖ for all v, v' ∈ closedBall(0, ρ).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (G : Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (x : Rn n) (ρ ε : ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G U → x ∈ U → 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (∀ v ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) ρ, x + t • v ∈ U) ∧ ∀ v ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) ρ, ∀ v' ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) ρ, ‖t⁻¹ • (G (x + t • v) - G (x + t • v')) - fderiv ℝ G x (v - v')‖ ≤ ε * ‖v - v'‖
